newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Thursday on low demand from spinners who have stocks to last till the new crop arrives early next month, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
Prices remained range-bound due to low demand in lacklustre trade and one dealer said exporters had slowed buying before next week's announcement of the 1997/98 (July-June) budget.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was quoted at 2,100/2,200 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), K-68 at 2,375/2,400 and MNH-93 at 2,400/2,425.
